questions.q: Have you ever been told to just believe when you wanted real answers?
questions.answer: One example: "Yes, I asked a hard question once and was just told to have faith, and I felt brushed off." The lesson says unanswered doubts are one reason people walk away.

questions.q: Why might learning more about your faith lead to even more questions?
questions.answer: The more you learn, the more you notice what you still don't understand. The lesson says that's normal, and working through those questions can make faith stronger.

questions.q: Does hearing that others have doubts too make it easier to share yours?
questions.answer: Yes. Knowing I'm not the only one makes it less scary to speak up. The lesson even says some of Jesus' own apostles doubted after seeing Him risen.
